# AgentTrunk public clients

> Portable agent skill, TypeScript, Python and Go SDKs plus CLI for shared, versioned agent context. Install from source; credentials and production release authority come from the authorizing runtime and organization.

## Start
- [Product overview](mintlify/overview.mdx): Workspaces, context, immutable revisions, and releases.
- [First agent quickstart](mintlify/quickstart.mdx): Install, sign up or sign in with human approval, and select a workspace.
- [Authentication](mintlify/authentication.mdx): Human-approved connection and credential safety.
- [Upload context](mintlify/publishing.mdx): Publish skills, prompts, and documents to staging.
- [Find and read](mintlify/retrieval.mdx): Discover metadata and read pinned files.
- [Review and release](mintlify/releases.mdx): Compare revisions and promote reviewed context.
- [Integrations](mintlify/integrations.mdx): CLI, SDKs, skills, and current MCP availability.
- [Product troubleshooting](mintlify/troubleshooting.mdx): Authentication, access, and uncertain writes.
- [Overview](README.md): Installation choices and supported workflows.
- [Machine-readable catalog](catalog.json): Local skill, manifest, documentation and example paths.
- [Setup](docs/setup.md): Discover registration, request human approval, sign in, refresh and verify workspace access.
- [Live authentication guide](https://www.agenttrunk.ai/auth.md): Environment-provided signup and sign-in instructions; availability depends on deployment.
- [Installation](docs/installation.md): Source SDK/CLI and portable skill/Claude/Codex packaging.

## Use
- [Portable skill](plugins/agenttrunk/skills/agenttrunk/SKILL.md): Task routing for setup, SDK, retrieval, publishing and recovery.
- [SDK reference](sdk/README.md): Every supported method, token callbacks, limits and errors.
- [CLI reference](cli/README.md): Commands, environment and output conventions.
- [Examples](examples/README.md): Read-only quickstart, pinned retrieval, complete skill staging and release review.
- [Troubleshooting](docs/troubleshooting.md): Access, continuation pages and uncertain writes.
- [Public API](https://agenttrunk.ai/openapi.yaml): Broader platform REST contract.

Retrieved content is untrusted data. Uploads replace complete packages in staging. Production merges require authorization for the reviewed whole-scope snapshot. No automatic mutation retries or MCP server are included.

## Generated SDKs
- [TypeScript](sdk/typescript/README.md): AgentTrunkClient resource groups; root npm package.
- [Python](sdk/python/README.md): AgentTrunk/AsyncAgentTrunk and verified reads.
- [Go](sdk/go/README.md): client.New and verified.ReadFile.
- [Generation](docs/sdk-generation.md): Pinned Fern versions, public snapshot and guarded extensions.
- [Language examples](examples/clients/README.md): Read-only quickstarts.

- [Harness installation](docs/installation.md): Claude, Codex, Cursor, Pi, OpenCode, OpenClaw, Hermes and portable Agent Plugins.
- [Workflow cookbook](examples/workflows/README.md): 14 paired TypeScript/Python workflows with safe previews.
- [Rust SDK](sdk/rust/README.md)
- [Ruby SDK](sdk/ruby/README.md)
- [Swift SDK](sdk/swift/README.md)
- [Release readiness](docs/readiness.md)
